usedFor: Keap Max Classic holds contacts, and Documint fills a document template when “New Contact Created” runs.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact Created” in Keap Max Classic, then “Add Content To Template” in Documint
bestTemplate.why: A new contact's details go into a template, so documents start from the CRM record.

watchOut: “Company Is Updated” fires on every edit, so the same company can fill a template more than once.
